label: Compare circular supply with admitted and exercised source-only alternatives
description: At true the source operation and adoption share their bearer and product is the same recipient's event. Actual nonempty paths survive in every route and induce the explicitly selected causal-credit and existential-token interpretations. The circular prerequisite pair blocks Supply in the first two routes; merely admitted alternatives are not exercised suppliers. An exercised alternative with only the independently supplied source operation constructs Supply for adoption and product. A rival primitive exercise seed restores Supply without adding a decision event. The accessible false world preserves source operation while lacking adoption/product, so actual exercise is not scenario sufficiency.
